assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create a wide 3:1 panoramic background illustration for a Chinese official local-history exhibition website, northwest China Yulin and the Mu Us desert in ancient times. A meticulously drafted Chinese gongbi landscape with dry ink engraving linework and subdued mineral pigments on warm old paper. Several spatial layers: distant pale wind-scoured sand dunes and loess plateaus, a long jagged Great Wall and sparse frontier beacon towers in the middle distance, a realistically proportioned squat stepped rectangular Ming Zhenbeitai-like tower and small traditional northwest courtyard roofs off-centre on the right, rugged tamarisk and worn stone rubble across foreground margins. Horizontal composition with distant ridge and buildings in LOWER HALF, sparse open warm parchment atmosphere above, absolutely no text. The attached real photograph is a STRUCTURAL reference only for the authentic stepped square tower, do not reproduce the modern greenery, do not mimic modern aerial photography. Chinese frontier desert, not fanciful Jiangnan, no pagoda forest, no waterfalls. Rich tactile linework, faded ochre/umber/charcoal, low saturation. Natural restrained hand-crafted heritage book illustration, no glossy 3D, no cinematic golden glow, no airbrushed concept art, no watercolor blobs, no artificial paper vignette, no poster lettering.

Use case: illustration-story. A 3:1 wide detailed panoramic illustration asset for a modern Yulin government history website: a horizontal layered skyline of a northwest Chinese city with contemporary civic buildings, modest apartment blocks, public library, broad tree-lined avenues, clusters of green poplars, landscaped public park and red sandstone/tan traditional courtyard roofs bridging heritage and the new city. Include unobtrusive red architectural detailing and small red flags on civic roofs. Distant buildings are pale blue-grey, middle buildings cream and terracotta red, foreground green canopy of trees forms a continuous horizontal low band. Blue sky and atmospheric mountains faint in upper half, buildings in LOWER HALF with enough calm sky for overlay text. Refined hand-drawn architectural publication rendering with very fine etched pen contours and restrained flat colour, factual and plausible architecture, not a sci-fi megacity, no skyscraper landmarks from other cities. Fairly bright and fresh red, green, cream, muted blue. No text, no watermark, no shiny 3D, no huge gradients, no whimsical cartoon, no cinematic glow, no generic AI fantasy illustration. High horizontal detail and naturally overlapping depth planes.

Use case: historical-scene. Generate a dedicated extremely beautiful 3:1 wide landscape artwork for the Chinese theme '绿水青山就是金山银山' and the successful ecological restoration of the Mu Us sandy land around Yulin, northwest China. Depict a plausible present-day restored sandy landscape from a gently elevated viewpoint: in foreground continuous native grasses, shrubs and cultivated shelterbelt trees, in middle distance an irregular river or wetland bordered by dense poplar and Scots pine forest belts and neat modest farmland, a small northwest village with tan courtyard homes set amongst green trees, and low rolling SANDY hills with patches of stabilized pale gold sand visible far behind the vegetation. A small trail and shelterbelt rows convey many decades of practical land management. The scene should communicate desert becoming an oasis but still be a NORTHWESTERN SEMIARID landscape, no lush subtropical jungle, no immense green alpine peaks, no fantastic waterfalls, no bright teal tropical lake. Rich fresh olive/forest greens, soft sandy ochre and realistic blue-grey water; calm sunlit atmosphere. Refined Chinese ecological exhibition illustration, fine dry pen contour drawing and transparent controlled mineral colour wash, meticulous natural land texture, nearly editorial documentary in spatial realism; no gloss, no plastic 3D, no broad mushy watercolor, no artificial AI glow, no text, no lettering or watermarks. Full landscape image, layered natural perspective. This is an artistic impression, not a fabricated historical before-after photograph.
